messages:
ops_bot: 🔔 Pager — HIGH: GPU pool saturation detected in us-west-2 (region). Queue length > 2k, 429s rising. Incident ID: INC-2026-03-14-01

monica: seeing huge queue growth on realtime-prod, autoscaler not adding nodes, existing nodes are at 100% memory. Customers getting 429s on generate endpoints.

ashley: confirmed. Dashboard shows sustained pending requests and token-bucket refill spikes. Rate limiter logs: 
```
rate_limit: tier=standard token_bucket_refill=0.0 tokens=0 pending=2178
errors: 429 component=serve_router
```

kevin: autoscale logs show repeated launch failures from AWS side: API throttles + image pull errors then scale capped by max_nodes=200 (set in dedicated pool config).

sre_oncall: initial triage — impact: hostable workloads see elevated tail latencies, failing requests returning 429. Some enterprise customers are on dedicated pools and affected. I'll page infra_pager for cloud-side issues and customer_success for outreach.

infra_pager: on it. I'm seeing a flurry of ENI attach/timeouts and Docker image pull 503s from ECR in us-west-2a which is slowing node boot. Autoscaler marks nodes as failed then hits burst_limit.

monica: we need immediate mitigation: 1) relax token bucket thresholds for standard tier to reduce 429s temporarily 2) increase fallback to smaller-but-compatible model variant for realtime-prod 3) open canary to non-critical customers to prevent cascading.

ashley: suggestion: set token_bucket.allow_burst=true and refill_rate += 30% for 10m; patch request rate limiter config via /api/configs/ratelimit (canary flag). Rolling this only on the gateway layer first.

kevin: deploying small model variant fallback for route /v1/generate -> model=redwood-xxs-8q now. This will reduce memory pressure on existing GPUs.

monica: do it. Ashley, can you make the token bucket change? Put a 10m TTL so it auto-reverts.

ashley: pushing patch now: 
```
PATCH /internal/configs/ratelimit HTTP/1.1
Host: control-plane
Body: {"tier": "standard", "refill_per_sec": 1.3, "burst": 120, "ttl": 600}
```
Rolled to gateway nodes in us-west-2. Watching.

ops_bot: config-deploy: ratelimit update rolled to 24/24 gateways in us-west-2. Roll ID: roll-20260314-01.

monica: early signals — 429 rate dropped by ~42%, queue drained to ~900. Still seeing some failed node boots.

infra_pager: opened support case with cloud provider. Meanwhile I'm enabling cross-zone placement to let autoscaler launch nodes in other AZs (us-west-2b,c). This may increase cold start but avoids a single-AZ ECR flakiness.

kevin: launched xxs fallback is in effect for ~20% of traffic via routing rule. Request success rate for routed traffic improved (p99 latency down 0.6s).

customer_success: drafting message to impacted customers. We should note degraded performance and temporary rate-limit relax as mitigation, plus ETA for full recovery TBD. Any enterprise customers with reserved Dedicated capacity to notify?

monica: yes, add accounts: AcmeAnalytics, Finport. Also include note about possible partial request retries if SDK has automatic retry.

ashley: FYI we found a config bug: token bucket capacities for 'standard' tier were set 10x lower than intended due to a units mismatch when a team member recently changed throttle_policy. That allowed the pool to hit hard 429s under bursty traffic. We'll include that in postmortem. For now we increased values and enabled burst.

sre_oncall: handoff — I'm going to mark incident as "active - mitigation in progress" and hand to night SRE Kevin who will monitor for 2 hours. Monica remains incident lead.

kevin: taking over monitoring. I'll keep infra_pager looped for node boot failures. If queue doesn't drop below 200 in 40m -> escalate to exec oncall and consider temporary quota increases for Dedicated customers.

infra_pager: cloud support says ECR had elevated 5xx in the region from 02:03-02:20 UTC; they've fixed it but rate of image pulls still catching up. Nodes are booting now but slowly.

monica: update for CS: we've relaxed rate limits for standard tier and routed a subset of traffic to smaller model variants to lower memory pressure. Autoscaler is recovering as AZ spread kicks in. No data-exfil or security issues.

customer_success: sending update now. Will loop back for confirmed list of impacted customers.

ops_bot: metric-alert: queue_length_us-west-2 dropped below 200 for 5m — alert cleared.

monica: great progress. Next steps for postmortem: 1) root cause: ECR region flakiness + token-bucket misconfig (units mismatch) 2) remediation: add CI check to validate throttle units, increase default token capacities, and implement autoscaler probe backoff tuning to allow cross-AZ fallback earlier 3) follow-up with cloud provider SLA.

ashley: I'll file the postmortem draft and include config diffs and commands used.

kevin: leaving monitoring on for 2h. If any regression, @monica or @sre_oncall ping me.

monica: thanks team. Closing active mitigation — moving to monitoring/RC phase. :white_check_mark:
